notes: Tier shelf; no archetypes. Merges: RGP, orthokeratology and scleral (k152–k154) became one "Rigid contact lens" kind with types. Solution and drops (k155–k156) became one care kind with types. Spectacle lens: added Zeiss, Hoya, Rodenstock and Nikon flagships beside Varilux. Design, material and coating ladders are now types, and Transitions and Crizal are coating lines. Soft lenses cut from 17 to 12 flagship models across the four main makers; schedule, correction and colour are types. Dropped: FreshLook ColorBlends (Air Optix Colors and 1-Day Acuvue Define cover coloured lenses); NovaKone (keratoconus specialty lens, which belongs to the rigid/specialty end); PureVision, Proclear and Acuvue Vita as SKUs (these lines stay in the brand register); Opti-Free Replenish (near-duplicate of Puremoist). Clear Care Plus and Opti-Free now have Alcon as maker, confirmed on the Alcon Clear Care page. Added from retrieved pages: Opti-Free Puremoist Rewetting Drops and Menicon Z. Frames are not here (they move to A4 Eyewear, another shelf). No craft traditions apply. Not done: the Zenlens page I fetched had redirected to a portal, so Zenlens stays from the old data. The Transitions GEN S page returned only its title. MyDay (CooperVision) was not added because I had no retrieved page for it.
